endpoint_cards.drain_posture: coordinate visible endpoint handoff; this is the user-facing old runtime

authority_relaunch.note: Derived raw server relaunch command only; this planner does not execute it. This preserves parsed server flags but does not enable the Brain/Workshop machine transport.

desktop_authority_handoff.note: DesktopRuntime is the intended founder-facing authority launch path, but this card is not executable evidence. A real handoff must prove the visible endpoint is free, the machine descriptor is not owned by another authority bridge, and the browser session can be transferred without falling back to a copied runtime.

endpoint_cards.allowed_action: keep running until the visible session is no longer needed, then relaunch from 10.PRODUCT/13.NODE-LANGUAGE with the same port/state arguments
endpoint_cards.forbidden_action: kill, move, or archive as an uncoordinated cleanup

rule: This board is read-only evidence. It may name a relaunch command, but it must not execute, kill, archive, or move any holder.
